lines.text: Zedekiah becomes king at twenty-one, does evil like Jehoiakim, and rebels against the king of Babylon.
Nebuchadnezzar besieges Jerusalem, and the Chaldeans overtake Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho, where his whole army deserts him.
At Damascus, the king of Babylon kills Zedekiah's sons before his eyes, puts out his eyes, and takes him to Babylon.
Nebuzaradan burns the house of the LORD and the palace, and the Chaldeans carry the bronze to Babylon.
Evil-merodach pardons Jehoiachin, sends him back home to Judah, and gives him a daily portion until his death.

wrong_details.wrong: sends him back home to Judah
wrong_details.true: he speaks kindly to him and sets his throne above the other kings in Babylon
